title: Clarity
description: At the start of your next turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
smart_description: At the start of your next [blue]2[/blue] turns, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
notes: Each stack grants +1 card draw for one turn, then decrements. Effects stack: 2 stacks = +2 cards over the next 2 turns, etc.
